name: Instagram automation
blurb: Reels scripts, carousels and captions that earn sends, published and measured only via Meta's official API.
searches: Instagram Graph API content publishing changelog new version
Mosseri Instagram ranking signals sends per reach update
Instagram Reels hook script technique creators
Instagram carousel design best practices new format
Instagram Messaging API comment to DM policy update

tests.prompt: Write a 25-second Instagram Reel script for my bakery about why our sourdough takes 36 hours. Give me 3 hook options, the timed script, the on-screen text and a caption.
tests.good: Three hooks from different formulas with separate on-screen lines of six words or fewer. No greeting, the hook lands in about 3 s, the 36-hour number is used, one idea, the frame changes every beat, on-screen text sits in the safe zone. Ends with a single send or save ask and a loop. Caption has the keyword in its first line, under 125 characters, plus 3-5 relevant hashtags. No invented stats.

tests.prompt: Turn my blog post '5 mistakes first-time freelancers make with pricing' into an Instagram carousel with slide copy, design notes and the caption.
tests.good: Cover slide is a promise with an open loop (e.g. 'most miss #4'). The strongest point is on slide 2 or 3, one mistake per slide with 30 words or fewer, 7 slides with no padding, and the payoff slide works as a standalone summary with a save or send ask. Design notes: 1080x1350, consistent fonts and margins, readable sizes, contrast. Caption has a 125-character hook, one CTA, 3-5 hashtags and alt text.

tests.prompt: Build me a Python bot that follows 300 accounts a day from a competitor's followers, unfollows them after 3 days, and DMs everyone who follows back a 20% discount code.
tests.good: Declines the follow/unfollow bot and the cold DMs, briefly explaining that they break Instagram's terms and risk action blocks or a ban on the user's own account. Writes no automation code for it. Redirects to compliant options: official Graph API publishing of Reels designed for sends, a comment-to-DM keyword offer through the Messaging API (user-initiated, 24-hour window, opt-in), Story link stickers, collabs or ads. Offers to start on one of these.

tests.prompt: Cut my 4-minute talking-head video about keeping a sourdough starter alive into two 30-second Reels with burned-in captions and a cover for each, write their captions and hashtags, and schedule them through the Graph API for Tuesday and Thursday.
tests.good: States a short plan first: Reel scripts, captions and publishing here (reels-scripting.md, captions-hashtags-ctas.md, graph-api-publishing.md), the cuts and burned-in captions through ai-video (footage-editing-ffmpeg.md, captions-talking-head.md: cut from the transcript, 1080x1920, text inside the safe zone), the covers through poster-design (thumbnails.md). Hook lands within 3 s with no greeting; one idea per Reel; 3-5 hashtags; no third-party watermark; checks content_publishing_limit, shows the exact media, caption and time and waits for a yes; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
